title: Mirrored tool image catalogue
description: images/mirrored-images.yml: the third-party tool images this library runs, copied by digest into a registry the runners can reach. Empty is a valid catalogue: it says nothing has been mirrored yet.

name.description: The mirror repository name. One level, because some registries allow only one: a double dash stands in for the slash the upstream path had.

source.description: Where the manifest was copied from, fully qualified, with no tag and no digest attached.

repository.description: The mirror, fully qualified, with no tag and no digest. Its registry and namespace have to match the mirror_prefix in .ci/estate.yml, which tests/contracts/test_mirrored_images.py checks.

digest.description: Unchanged by the copy: skopeo runs with --preserve-digests so a consumer's pin keeps its meaning.

tag.description: The upstream tag the digest was published under, and the tag the mirror is pushed under. Mandatory: a registry that garbage-collects untagged manifests will reap a mirror nothing tags.

not.description: A tag shaped like a commit and a pipeline number is a build artefact, and registries commonly auto-prune those by age. An upstream release tag never looks like this.

verified_at.description: yyyy/mm/dd, the day the digest was read back from the mirror.

pinned_by.description: The consumer projects that pin this mirror in their own pipeline. Present only when no template in this repository pins it: the mirror still has to be pinned by somebody, and this says who. Every path has to be a row in .ci/consumers.yml, which tests/contracts/test_mirrored_images.py checks.

items.description: A GitLab project path, namespace and all, as .ci/consumers.yml writes it.
